patch_description: Building on the highest-scoring prior design (single shared "theta" parameter driving RX/RY/RZ layers plus an alternating XX/CZ nearest-neighbor ring, which achieved combined score 0.80 with fast 30-step convergence), I replace the current 20-parameter, group-of-8 RY/RZ design (score 0.68) with that stronger topology, and additionally enrich the lightweight skip-2 sub-ring by replacing its zero-parameter CZ gates with parametrized CRY gates that all reuse a single new shared parameter "theta_e". This keeps the total trainable-parameter count at just 2 (theta, theta_e) — far fewer than the current 20 — while adding genuine tunable expressivity to the skip-2 connections instead of fixed CZ, which should help maintain full train/val/test accuracy with even better parameter economy and comparable or better convergence speed, since the skip-2 interactions can now be optimized rather than fixed.
